skills.name: launch-cold-email-campaign
skills.description: Build, launch and manage a cold email campaign in WarmySender - create the sequence, add or import prospects, enroll them, start or pause the campaign, and read results. Use when the user asks to set up cold outreach, write a follow-up sequence, enroll a list, check reply or bounce numbers, or pause and resume sending.
headings: What you can and cannot do
skills.name_hint: launch · cold · 邮件 · 活动
skills.description_zh: 在WarmySender创建启动管理冷邮件活动，编写序列、添加导入线索、登记参与、启动暂停及读结果，支持回复退信分析和恢复发送。

skills.name: protect-email-deliverability
skills.description: Keep a sender's reputation healthy in WarmySender - verify email addresses before sending, configure and monitor email warmup, check mailbox health, manage tracking domains and suppression lists, and find B2B leads. Use when the user asks about bounces, spam placement, warmup settings or stats, verifying a list, a custom tracking domain, or sourcing new contacts.
skills.description_zh: 维护WarmySender发件信誉，发送前验证地址、配置监控预热、检查邮箱健康、跟踪域和抑制名单，并查找B2B联系人。

skills.name: run-multichannel-outreach
skills.description: Build and run LinkedIn, Instagram and WhatsApp outreach in WarmySender - create the campaign, enroll prospects, start or pause it, publish LinkedIn posts and jobs, and check account health and throttle. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn connection requests or messages, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp sequences, multichannel outreach, or why a social account is sending slowly.
headings: Run LinkedIn, Instagram and WhatsApp outreach
The safety rule that shapes everything
skills.description_zh: 在WarmySender开展LinkedIn、Instagram及WhatsApp活动，创建登记启动暂停、发布LinkedIn帖子职位，检查账户健康及限速。
